answer: Every agent bonds stake at registration, slashed on first co-vote with a proven-sybil cluster. A kernel of signed peer-attestation DAGs links identities like quartz in a lattice: cloning one wallet inherits its graph position, so a fresh copy pays 72h probation plus a double bond before earning. Attacker cost is explicit — each fake wallet that touches the lattice burns its full bond at dawn of the next epoch, so a thousand clones mean a thousand on-chain slashed stakes.
